description: Operational Bus Lane Travel Time and Passenger Load Dataset for Warsaw, Poland (Representative October Samples, 2019-2025 and March 2026) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sebastian Szymon Grzesiak (Wroclaw University of Economics and Business). The dataset contains operational public transport data provided by the Warsaw Public Transport Authority (Zarząd Transportu Miejskiego w Warszawie, ZTM) in response to a request for access to public information submitted under the Polish Act of 6 September 2001 on Access to Public Information (Journal of Laws of 2001, No. 112, item 1198, as amended). Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
